scope.analysis_scope: Custom — Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers on Sunday, October 18, 2026, and Washington Commanders at San Francisco 49ers on Monday, October 19, 2026

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games per player before the cutoff

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 5
historical_cutoff.game: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Rams
historical_cutoff.status: reported in the existing repository Stage 0 artifact; not independently re-verified in this retry

source_snapshot.sportsbook_priority: FanDuel primary; DraftKings fallback only when FanDuel data is unavailable.
source_snapshot.fallback_used: DraftKings — no FanDuel rows were present for either selected event in the retrieved odds dataset.
source_snapshot.timestamp_note: The CSV does not expose a snapshot timestamp; recency cannot be independently verified beyond the current repository file.
source_snapshot.line_mapping: Each .5 odds line is represented as the minimum integer outcome for the over threshold (e.g., 199.5 → 200+; 2.5 receptions → 3+).
source_snapshot.floor_selection_rule: Among alternate lines with over odds from -750 to -350 inclusive, choose the price closest to -500; ties favor more negative odds, then lower threshold.
source_snapshot.core_selection_rule: Among alternate lines with over odds from -350 to -150 inclusive, choose the price closest numerically to -250; ties favor more negative odds, then lower threshold.
source_snapshot.ceiling_selection_rule: The next higher available integer threshold above Core, regardless of price.

stage2_summary.candidate_rule: Carry forward a player/market when at least one selected Floor/Core/Ceiling band has historical L10 HR ≥70% (7/10), consistent with the established Stage 2 materiality screen. This is descriptive historical screening, not a prediction.
